purpose: Every MCP tool name a skill may cite in backticks. scripts/validate-skills.py errors on a backticked snake_case tool-shaped token that is neither here nor in notTools.

mcp-0.4.4-fullaccess.note: the FullAccess tool set of MCP 0.4.4 as returned by tools/list. A key with narrower permissions lists a subset, so a name missing from a running server is a permission question before it is an existence question. This is the primary truth for 0.4.4.

mcp-0.4.x-narrow.note: a second server captured with a narrower key. It carries singular id getters (get_page_by_id, get_product_by_id, get_user_by_id) that 0.4.4 FullAccess replaces with plural batch getters (get_pages_by_ids, get_products_by_ids, get_users_by_ids); prefer the plural forms when writing for 0.4.4.

optional-add-in.mcpVersion: not in the standard tool set
optional-add-in.note: tools no captured tools/list registers. They ship, if at all, in an optional migration add-in on top of the standard Dynamicweb MCP add-in. A skill citing one states that availability is build-dependent and names what the reader does when tools/list does not carry it.
